$comment: Canonical NEXUS slide layouts. Single source of truth for backend (backend/agent/layouts_registry.py) and frontend (frontend/src/design/registry.js). Adding a layout here without renderer + normalizer support will cause the verify-layouts script and backend layout-coverage tests to fail.

layouts.name: title
layouts.description: Cover slide. Always pinned to slide index 0 by the agent normalizer.

layouts.name: bullets
layouts.description: Up to four bullet points. Default fallback when an unknown layout is received.

layouts.name: two-col
layouts.description: Two side-by-side columns, each with a heading and body.

layouts.name: stats
layouts.description: Up to three value/label statistic cards.

layouts.name: chart
layouts.description: Bar / line / doughnut chart driven by chart_data labels and values.

layouts.name: closing
layouts.description: Closing slide with CTA. Always pinned to the last slide index by the agent normalizer.

layouts.name: bigstat
layouts.description: Single dominant metric. Hero-sized value + label with optional supporting subtitle. Exporter falls back to stats render if unsupported.

layouts.name: section_divider
layouts.description: Pure typography pause between deck sections. Centered eyebrow + large title + optional subtitle. Exporter falls back to title render if unsupported.

layouts.name: timeline
layouts.description: Horizontal chronology of 3-6 dated events. Each event has date + label. Exporter falls back to bullets render if unsupported.

layouts.name: comparison
layouts.description: Side-by-side comparison with explicit framing (left vs right). Each side has heading and body. Exporter falls back to two-col render if unsupported.
